description: Use this at Step 2.5 — AFTER the orchestrator reports the build green, before the submission is filed — to produce the hackathon's demo video autonomously on the user's machine: it writes a scene-by-scene demo script from the brief/spec/event.md, records the built app scene-by-scene (Playwright screencast for browser scenes, ffmpeg gfxcapture/ddagrab for native/wallet-popup scenes), narrates with TTS and word-timed captions, assembles with Remotion, runs a frame-level QC loop, has the user WATCH the final cut, then — on a separate consent — uploads it and resolves the submission draft's demo-video URL. Trigger it ONLY on the user's ask: "make the demo video", "record the demo", "create the hackathon video", "do the demo studio", the user starting Step 2.5 after the orchestrator's offer, or an autopilot dispatch under a locked campaign contract (which counts as the user's start). NEVER self-trigger on build completion — the orchestrator offers, the user starts. It records under a foreground do-not-disturb session and never publishes without the user watching first — unless the locked contract's explicit WATCH policy delegates that watch (autopilot mode; references/campaign-contract.md). Do NOT use it to build (that's the orchestrator) or to run the faucet/deploy/signup gates (that's the gate-concierge).
